title: Mooncakes
description: Mooncakes is a China dish made with all-purpose flour, baking soda, red bean paste (anko), chicken egg. This home-scale recipe assigns measured ingredients to the steps where they are used. Red bean paste replaces traditional lotus seed filling; alkaline water is approximated with a tiny amount of baking soda.

steps.instruction: Mix the dough ingredients, knead until smooth and elastic, then cover and rest for about 15 minutes.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Roll or press the prepared dough evenly into the desired thickness and shape.
Roast in a preheated 190°C oven for about 24 minutes until nicely browned and fully cooked; turn once if needed.
Cool the prepared ingredients promptly, then refrigerate for about 30 minutes until properly chilled.
